question: Who become Wisden's Leading Cricketer in the world 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Virat Kohli.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Virat Kohli became Wisden's Leading Cricketer in the world 2018.**
 
• **Kohli scored 2735 runs across all formats in 2018, which was more than any other player.**
 
• He also scored **11 international centuries in 2018,** which was the most by any player.
 
• Kohli led India to historic Test series wins in **South Africa and Australia in 2018.**
 
• Wisden is a **cricket reference book **published annually in the United Kingdom.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rohit Sharma is an Indian cricketer who is the vice-captain of the Indian national team in limited-overs formats.**

 
 
• He is known for his aggressive batting style and has scored three double centuries in One Day Internationals (ODIs).
 
 
 
• **Kane Williamson is a New Zealand cricketer who is the current captain of the New Zealand national team in all formats.**
 
 
• He is known for his elegant batting style and has scored 22 Test centuries.
 
 
 
• **Ben Stokes is an English cricketer who is an all-rounder and plays for the England national team.**
 
 
• He is known for his aggressive batting and bowling and has played a key role in England's recent success in limited-overs cricket.
